summary: Abbreviate months and states per AP style, abbreviating months only with a specific day, and lists the abbreviations.
questions: How should I abbreviate months in docs?
How are US states abbreviated in Ansible style?

answer_card.title: Months and states
answer_card.answer_md: Follow AP style. Abbreviate months only with a day ("Jan. 12", but "January 1999"): Jan., Feb., Aug., Sept., Oct., Nov., Dec.; March to July are never abbreviated. States: Ala., Ariz., Calif., Colo., ... NY, NC, etc.
